metadata.title: Terms of use for the Room of Silence
metadata.classification_notes: This page describes the usage rules for the Room of Silence, a quiet retreat space on campus intended for reflection, prayer, or rest. It is student-facing, supports inclusive campus access, and is informational in nature rather than an academic rule or administrative process.

content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Campus Campus for All Retreats Terms of use for the Room of Silence Terms of use for the Room of Silence This room is open to all members of the University to relax, meditate or pray. Please leave your shoes in the anteroom. Eating, drinking and smoking are not permitted in this room. The Room of Silence has a deliberately neutral design. Please do not attach any pictures to the walls or leave any objects behind. The Room of Silence is used by different people. Mutual respect is essential in order to ensure an open space like this can function. A room divider is available so that several people can use the space at the same time. However, please stay here only as long as necessary so that as many people as possible can use the room for themselves and in peace. If you notice any damage to the room or the equipment , please report this to the Technical Services department using the contact form . If you require assistance , please call the security team: Wilhelminenhof campus: (030) 5019-3000 Treskowallee campus: (030) 5019-2000
